summary: Clearwater NF 50 ft L-4 tower; built 1932 or 1934 (sources differ), fire-damaged 1934, abandoned 1950s, burned about 1960; listed as gone.

facts.status_note: Cabin and tower declared surplus about 1960 and the tower destroyed by burning; firelookout.com and the St. Joe-Clearwater listing both say gone.

events.note: firelookout.com and the Forest Service list give 1934; Hartig's 1981 history gives 1932 (see resolved_conflicts)
Fire closed in and the lookout had to evacuate the cabin; one tower leg was badly burned and had to be replaced
Listed as abandoned in the 1950s (decade only)
Cabin and tower declared surplus about 1960; tower destroyed by burning

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Hartig's 1981 history says the Selway National Forest built the tower in 1932; firelookout.com and the Forest Service list give 1934. The story reports both and does not pick one.
Hartig's 1981 history names the Selway National Forest at construction; firelookout.com and the Forest Service list name the Clearwater National Forest. The brief's agency is kept.

notes_for_editor: Gone tower; no source we read describes the site today. Brief record (L-4, 50 ft, gone, Clearwater NF) matches the sources, so no corrections. The 1932 vs 1934 build year is unresolved. The 'Drive Up' tag comes only from idahofirelookouts.com and does not say whether a road reaches the site now. No photos found.
